title: Queen City Racquet & Fitness Club

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Skill-based drills and tactical instruction from 9am-10:30am. Campers are grouped by age and level to ensure maximum growth on the court. Campers take a short break and are encouraged to bring a healthy, energizing snack. Then back on court for game based drills and point play until 12pm. During our midday break, kids enjoy an hour-long lunch. You can bring food from home or buy from our cafe. We spend this time outdoors playing yard games and enjoying the playground before heading back on the courts for match practice. Wind down the day at our Olympic-sized swimming pool.
